scope: Independent design/plan source review only; no implementation or Julia admission

findings.title: Distinguish unobserved cause from a solve that did not run
findings.evidence: Detailed outcomes are requested only in eligible new scope, but strict/unspecified weight calls still execute legacy refinement. The current not_run sentinel is restricted to skipped/nonattempted row, so the fixed-size result lacks a truthful refinement_cause for such an ineligible legacy refusal.
findings.requested_change: Use metadata-only not_observed/unobserved meaning terminal-cause collection was not requested, including skipped rows; do not force detailed outcome creation or change strict legacy work to populate metadata.

unnecessary_work_memory_assessment: No unnecessary normal-path scans/solves/retained arrays proposed. Single failed-row self-dot reduction is now explicit and replaces redundant finite-direction scan. Metadata sentinel wording must not force detailed outcome construction on legacy strict paths; default allocation/boxing remains future measurement.

resolved_findings.title: Make the failed-row norm guard explicit before fallback readiness
resolved_findings.evidence: Current src/simplex_recovery.jl:145 rejects unreliable refinement before dot(direction,direction) at146 and its finite/positive check at147. A zero direction with a zero correction can produce finite-unreliable unchanged quality; a finite huge direction can produce a nonfinite squared norm. The Task2 bullet61 classifier permits both unless it adds a norm gate; bullet60 and spec15 require rejection. The fallback work ledger currently names only a finite-direction scan.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Require exactly one existing-order dot(direction,direction) plus finite/positive check on an otherwise eligible unreliable row before returning fallback_ready=true; preserve reliable-row arithmetic/check order, avoid duplicate norm work, and add this O(m) reduction to spec/plan ledgers. Pin zero and overflow finite-unreliable controls in later tests. An alternate consistent design must explicitly resolve the invalid-norm exclusion instead.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit single self-dot original finite-positive guard added to eligible failed row, redundant finite scan excluded, both ledgers updated.
